newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill Shi'ite activist in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill Shi'ite activist in Pakistan.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen killed a Shi'ite Moslem activist in the Pakistani town of Jahanian in Punjab province on Wednesday, witnesses and police said.
Police said Ashiq Hussain, who belonged to a local Shi'ite organisation, was shot by two motorcyclists with automatic weapons near his home in Jahanian, 45 km (26 miles) east of Multan.
"The motorcyclists drove away chanting anti-Shi'ite slogans," one witness said.
There was no immediate claim of responsibility for the attack.
Gunmen shot dead a senior Punjab provincial government official, who was a Sunni Moslem, in Lahore on Monday.
Wednesday's shooting appeared to be the latest incident in a long-running feud between militant Sunni and Shi'ite groups that cost at least 170 lives in Pakistan last year.
